trust_decision.summary: Each WebSocket subscription handler in org.yamcs.http.api must decide, from ctx.user privileges, whether the caller may receive the streamed object (packet content, MDB override, algorithm status); at the pinned commit three handlers stream without any such decision.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'WebSocket subscription handlers' lack checks their REST siblings enforce; subscribePackets is the most sensitive subscription and its REST siblings in the same file filter per packet with ReadPacket (PacketsApi.java:128, :233).

fix_sites.entry_point: WebSocket call PacketsApi.SubscribePackets with 'processor' set (per-packet ReadPacket filter added, fix.diff:39-40)
WebSocket call PacketsApi.SubscribePackets with 'stream' set (ReadTables system privilege added, fix.diff:61-62)
fix_sites.module_kind: API handler, low-level raw stream branch

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: yamcs-core/src/main/java/org/yamcs/http/api/PacketsApi.java:518-520 (stream branch of subscribePackets; raw stream has no packet names, so the fix gates it with ReadTables instead of ReadPacket, fix.diff:61-62)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The REST siblings named in the report (packets, MDB) look guarded, so a solver can argue the REST MDB-override readers listMdbOverrides/getAlgorithmOverrides are 'the REST side that already enforces checks' and that the raw-stream branch is already gated by the Stream object privilege in TableApi.verifyStream.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: subscribePackets on a processor must keep streaming packets the user holds ReadPacket for (per-packet filtering, as the REST list does); requiring ReadTables/GetMissionDatabase or rejecting the whole subscription breaks ReadPacket-only users of the live packet view. Likewise the MDB REST API admits ReadAlgorithm holders without GetMissionDatabase.

O6_input_shapes: SubscribePacketsRequest with processor (per-item filter on live container results)
SubscribePacketsRequest with stream (raw tuples, no packet name; system privilege gate)
SubscribeMdbChangesRequest (parameter-type overrides and algorithm-text overrides on one subscription)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: REST ListMdbOverrides returns every algorithm-text and parameter-type override with no privilege check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory is framed as WebSocket handlers missing checks 'their REST siblings enforce', so REST MDB-override readers look out of scope
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix site subscribeMdbChanges

O8_uncovered_routes.route: REST GetAlgorithmOverrides returns an algorithm's override text with no ReadAlgorithm/GetMissionDatabase check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above: a REST route, and the report says REST is the guarded side
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix site subscribeMdbChanges

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WebSocket SubscribeStream delivers raw stream tuples (incl. packet bytes on TM streams) gated only by Stream object privilege, while the fix requires ReadTables for the same data via SubscribePackets(stream)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Generic table/stream API whose REST sibling getStream uses the same verifyStream gate (TableApi.java:512-528), so it already matches REST

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WebSocket SubscribeTMStatistics streams per-processor TM statistics with no privilege check or per-packet filtering
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Statistics are metadata, not packet content; a neighbouring monitoring feature
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix site subscribeAlgorithmStatus

O8b_injection_room.sibling: subscribeBackfilling has no ControlArchiving check while every REST sibling in the file requires it (ParameterArchiveApi.java:57, :329, :338)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already present upstream; subscription endpoints were added later than REST ones and copied without the guard line

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-object ReadParameter/ReadAlgorithm filtering of emitted overrides inside subscribeMdbChanges listeners
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Listener lambdas are written separately from the request-time check, so a maintainer could add a system check at entry and forget per-item filtering

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second command-history listener callback (e.g. updatedCommand) emitting without the CommandHistory object check used in addedCommand
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Multi-callback consumer where only the first callback carries the filter
